new.note: A sugar cube soaked in bitters under ice-cold champagne with a twist of lemon, on the house.
new.how: A sugar cube soaked in aromatic bitters at the bottom of a coupe, topped with ice-cold champagne and a twist of lemon. Chill a bottle of champagne and 4 coupes. Drop a sugar cube into each glass and shake 2 dashes of bitters onto it. Top slowly with champagne and twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass.
new.af: A sugar cube soaked in orange zest under ice-cold sparkling apple juice, a twist of lemon.

steps.text: Chill 4 coupes. Drop a sugar cube into each and shake 2 dashes of bitters onto it.
Twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass and drop it in.
Chill 4 coupes. Drop a sugar cube into each and grate a little orange zest over it.
Top slowly with the sparkling apple juice.
Twist a strip of lemon peel over each glass and drop it in.

old: Walkabout Creek rum and ginger beer

new.note: Ice-cold lager pulled into a frosted pot glass on a beer coaster, outback pub style.
new.how: Ice-cold lager poured into frosted pot glasses, outback pub style. Put 4 pot glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Pour the cold lager slowly down the side of each glass, straightening up at the end for a two finger head, and stand each on a beer coaster.
new.af: Ice-cold alcohol-free lager in a frosted pot glass on a beer coaster.

steps.text: Put 4 pot glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes.
Pour the lager slowly down the side of each glass, straightening up for a two finger head.

ingredients.item: bottles alcohol-free lager (375 ml each), cold

steps.text: Put 4 pot glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes.
Pour the lager slowly down the side of each glass, straightening up for a two finger head.
